name: pixel-haxe
description: Pixel Api — Hafif ve cok hedefli Haxe API mikro-framework'u. A lightweight, multi-target Haxe API micro-framework. Router, route groups, middleware, CORS, JSON, cookies, Bearer auth, rate limiting and static file serving; runs on Node.js, PHP, Neko and HashLink.
releasenote: v0.2.0: rota gruplari, rotaya ozel middleware, Bearer token auth, hiz sinirlama, cookie destegi, 405 + Allow, ozel 404/hata isleyicileri. Route groups, route-scoped middleware, Bearer auth, rate limiting, cookies, 405 + Allow and custom 404/error handlers.
